releases.title: Installed models keep their check mark and the rest show Available

sections.title: Improved
items: Models dialog: a file you already have keeps its check mark (greyed out, it cannot be picked again), and a card whose files are all installed is ticked too. Install Selected still counts only the files that are left to download.

Models dialog: a file that is not installed is now badged Available in yellow instead of Missing in red. These files come in many versions and nobody needs all of them, so Missing suggested something was wrong. This covers the MiniMax H3, Image Models, LLM Models and DMAD LoRA tabs. Files that need a Hugging Face login show Login needed in orange.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Only the web page changed in this build, so updating needs no restart. Refresh the browser page to see it.

releases.title: Install models from the Models dialog, a Hugging Face token box and a Restart ComfyUI button

sections.title: Added
items: Models > MiniMax H3, Image Models and LLM Models now install their files for you. Every file has a check box and each card says how much is still to download. Install Recommended downloads the files the Builder uses by default, Install Selected downloads the ticked ones, and every file is saved into the right ComfyUI folder (diffusion_models, text_encoders, vae, loras, latent_upscale_models or models/LLM). Downloads show their progress and can be cancelled, a finished file is checked before it gets its name, a file you already have is never replaced, and installed files show as Installed.

Added a Hugging Face token box at the top of those tabs, with Save Token, Test Token, Remove Token and Create a Token. A saved token lets the installer fetch files Hugging Face keeps behind a login, such as the Flux/Klein 9B diffusion model. Accept the model's licence on its Hugging Face page with the same account first. The token is saved in a file of its own in ComfyUI's output folder (VRGDG_Model_Defaults/hf_token.json), is never shown again and is sent only to huggingface.co.

Added a Restart ComfyUI button next to the engine badge at the top right. It asks first and says how many running or queued jobs a restart would lose, then asks ComfyUI-Manager to restart ComfyUI and waits until ComfyUI answers again.

sections.title: Improved
items: Models > LLM Models shows the Gemma and Qwen files as two cards on one tab, and the MiniMax H3 folder note lists the loras and latent_upscale_models folders too.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed the Custom Nodes window offering the MiniMax H3 Audio T8 pack again after it was installed. ComfyUI-Manager saves it in a folder named minimax-h3-audio-t8, and the window now knows that name.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI and refresh the page after updating, so the new routes and the new buttons load.
The Restart ComfyUI button needs ComfyUI-Manager with a security level of normal or lower. Without the Manager, or when it refuses, the button says so and nothing restarts.
A file Hugging Face keeps behind a login still opens its model page until a token is saved.

releases.title: The pack's requirements no longer downgrade protobuf

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed ComfyUI-Manager downgrading protobuf when it installed the pack's requirements. The pack asked for google-generativeai, which pins protobuf below 6, so Manager pulled protobuf down and other node packs that need a newer one stopped working (onnx no longer imported). The package is not required any more. Gemini in the LLM runner and NanoBanana Pro works as before: it uses google-genai when that is installed and a direct REST call otherwise.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: No code changed in this build, so updating needs no restart.

If protobuf was already downgraded on your install, run python_embeded\python.exe -m pip install -U protobuf from the ComfyUI folder, then restart ComfyUI. If nothing else of yours uses google-generativeai, remove it with pip uninstall google-generativeai google-ai-generativelanguage so a later pip run does not pin protobuf again.

releases.title: RTX resize fallback, MOSS-Image LoRA installs, a working Snap and LLM names in the Builder

sections.title: Added
items: Added an nvidia-vfx card to the Custom Nodes window. It installs the optional NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution library with pip from NVIDIA's index (about 800 MB) without ComfyUI-Manager, and Install Missing Nodes leaves it alone.

sections.title: Improved
items: Labels, tooltips, placeholders and messages in the Video Builder now name the LLM Runner you selected (LM Studio, LLM API, Qwen Local or Custom Server) instead of always saying Gemma. Gemma Local keeps its wording, and the Gemma-only settings, Prompt Creator and the built-in Gemma4 Draft still say Gemma.

The MOSS-Image 8-step Turbo LoRA button in Models > Image Models now installs the file itself, like the Edit LoRA button, and saves it as moss_image_sft_8_steps_dmd_lora.safetensors instead of lora.safetensors.
The Edit LoRA button is now labelled Edit LoRA, and the MOSS-Image folder notes no longer ask you to rename either LoRA file.
Reference card prompts use the neutral route /vrgdg/music_builder/reference_image_prompt. The old flux_reference_zimage_prompt path still works.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed MiniMax H3 2 Pass renders failing at the very last node when nvidia-vfx is not installed. The final resize now falls back from nvidia_rtx_vsr to lanczos, and the console prints the pip command that installs the library.

Fixed Snap in the agent API and the song pipeline (pipeline_from_song): scope all did nothing and still reported that it had snapped, and all_starts put every boundary back where it was. Boundaries within 0.14 s of a beat now move onto it, scenes with a locked video are skipped, an unknown scope is refused, and the answer reports how many scenes moved.

Fixed the full-video and first/last-frame pipelines reading image_path from the image result when approving a scene image. The result holds saved_path, and approval only worked by falling back to the newest image in the history.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI after updating, then hard-refresh the browser so the revised Video Builder JavaScript is loaded.
NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU and the nvidia-vfx library. Without it the final resize uses lanczos.
H3 Studio 0.1.28 carries the same changes.

releases.title: ComfyUI's built-in MiniMax H3 latent upscaler

sections.title: Added
items: The Video Builder's learned latent upscale nodes now use the MiniMax H3 latent upscaler that is built into ComfyUI 0.44.0 and newer, so those versions no longer need the Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler custom node pack. ComfyUI chooses device and precision there, so the loader's device and precision inputs are ignored.
The Custom Nodes window reports your ComfyUI version, shows the upscaler pack as Built in on 0.44.0 and newer, and skips it in Install Missing Nodes.

sections.title: Improved
items: Older ComfyUI is unchanged: the nodes load the pack's backend as before. Without that pack the error now says to update ComfyUI to 0.44.0 or newer, or install the pack.
Saved workflows keep working, because the node inputs and outputs are the same on both paths.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI after updating.
Comfyui-MMH3-UltimateUpscale has no built-in replacement and is still required for 2 Pass Advanced.
The latent-upscaler checkpoint (minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors) must be installed separately either way.
H3 Studio 0.1.27 matches: its Custom Nodes window now asks this pack in ComfyUI, so Install and Install Missing Nodes work from the app.
